Regulation: B.C. Reg. 96/2026
Made under: Information Management Act
Published in: No. 11 – B.C. Regs. 94 to 98, June 16, 2026
Deposit date: June 5, 2026

B.C. Reg. 96/2026, deposited June 5, 2026, under theINFORMATION MANAGEMENT ACT[section 22]. Order in Council 222/2026, approved and ordered June 5, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that the Information Management Regulation, B.C. Reg. 109/2016, is amended as set out in the attached Appendix. — D. GIBSON,Minister of Citizens’ Services; S. MALCOLMSON,Presiding Member of the Executive Council. 1	The Schedule to the Information Management Regulation, B.C. Reg. 109/2016, is repealed and the following substituted: Column 2Head of Government Body BC Financial Services Authority Board of Examiners for Local Government British Columbia Emergency Health Services Authority Chair of the Board of Directors British Columbia Energy Regulator British Columbia Housing Management Commission British Columbia Innovation Council British Columbia Lottery Corporation Chair of the Board of Directors British Columbia Pavilion Corporation Chair of the Board of Directors British Columbia Securities Commission British Columbia Transit Corporation Chair of the Board of Directors British Columbia Transportation Financing Authority

minutes_briefs.title: BC updates Information Management Regulation to reflect new heads of government bodies
minutes_briefs.summary: British Columbia has updated its Information Management Regulation, which sets out who is responsible for managing government information. The change replaces the list of 'heads' (the people in charge) for several government bodies, including BC Lottery Corporation, BC Transit, and BC Securities Commission. This keeps the regulation current with changes in leadership and ensures the right people are named as responsible for information management.
